title: orchis mascula subsp. pinetorum
intro: Orchis mascula subsp. pinetorum, commonly known as the Pyrenean orchid, is a subspecies of the early purple orchid, a perennial plant native to the Pyrenees mountains. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Orchis mascula subsp. pinetorum are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system and improve cardiovascular function, while also being used to treat respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
